arxiv-1909-04821.title: Real Time Dynamics and Confinement in the ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n} Schwinger-Weyl lattice model for 1+1 QED
arxiv-1909-04821.creator: Giuseppe Magnifico, Marcello Dalmonte, Paolo Facchi, Saverio Pascazio, Francesco V. Pepe, Elisa Ercolessi
arxiv-1909-04821.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Giuseppe Magnifico, Marcello Dalmonte, Paolo Facchi, Saverio Pascazio, Francesco V. Pepe, Elisa Ercolessi. We study the out-of-equilibrium properties of 1 + 1 1+1 dimensional quantum electrodynamics (QED), discretized via the staggered-fermion Schwinger model with an Abelian ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n} gauge group. We look at two relevant phenomena: first, we analyze the stability of the Dirac vacuum with respect to particle/antiparticle pair production, both spontaneous and induced by an external electric field; then, we examine the string breaking mechanism.

The derivative d λ ​ E d_{\lambda}E is fully consistent with the dependence E ⁡ ( λ ) E(\lambda) of the energy computed with the same time step.

arxiv-2106-05716.title: Fastening the Initial Access in 5G NR Sidelink for 6G V2X Networks
arxiv-2106-05716.creator: Marouan Mizmizi, Francesco Linsalata, Mattia Brambilla, Filippo Morandi, Kai Dong, Maurizio Magarini, Monica Nicoli, Majid Nasiri Khormuji, Peng Wang, Renaud Alexandre Pitaval, Umberto Spagnolini
arxiv-2106-05716.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Marouan Mizmizi, Francesco Linsalata, Mattia Brambilla, Filippo Morandi, Kai Dong, Maurizio Magarini, Monica Nicoli, Majid Nasiri Khormuji, Peng Wang, Renaud Alexandre Pitaval, Umberto Spagnolini. The ever-increasing demand for intelligent, automated, and connected mobility solutions pushes for the development of an innovative sixth Generation (6G) of cellular networks. A radical transformation on the physical layer of vehicular communications is planned, with a paradigm shift towards beam-based millimeter Waves or sub-Terahertz communications, which require precise beam pointing for guaranteeing the communication link, especially in high mobility.

arxiv-2111-13470.title: TDAM: Top-Down Attention Module for Contextually Guided Feature Selection in CNNs
arxiv-2111-13470.creator: Shantanu Jaiswal, Basura Fernando, Cheston Tan
arxiv-2111-13470.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shantanu Jaiswal, Basura Fernando, Cheston Tan. Attention modules for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are an effective method to enhance performance on multiple computer-vision tasks. While existing methods appropriately model channel-, spatial- and self-attention, they primarily operate in a feedforward bottom-up manner.

arxiv-2208-09546.title: MISO Wireless Localization in The Presence of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface
arxiv-2208-09546.creator: Sajjad Ghiasvand, Arash Nasri, Ali H. Abdollahi Bafghi, Masoumeh Nasiri-Kenari
arxiv-2208-09546.description: Abstract Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) can play a pivotal role in enhancing communication rate and localization accuracy. In this letter, we propose a positioning algorithm in a RIS-assisted environment, where the Base Station (BS) is multi-antenna, and the Mobile Station (MS) is single-antenna. We show that our method can achieve a high-precision positioning if three RISs are available.

arxiv-2308-08078.title: Existence and analyticity of solutions of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation with singular data
arxiv-2308-08078.creator: David M. Ambrose, Milton C. Lopes Filho, Helena J. Nussenzveig Lopes
arxiv-2308-08078.description: Abstract . We prove existence of solutions to the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation with low-regularity data, in function spaces based on the Wiener algebra and in pseudomeasure spaces. In any spatial dimension, we allow the data to have its antiderivative in the Wiener algebra. In one spatial dimension, we also allow data which is in a pseudomeasure space of negative order.

arxiv-2505-03003.title: Probing Vortex Dynamics in 2D Superconductors with Scanning Quantum Microscope
arxiv-2505-03003.creator: Sreehari Jayaram, Malik Lenger, Dong Zhao, Lucas Pupim, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Ruoming Peng, Marc Scheffler, Rainer Stöhr, Mathias S. Scheurer, Jurgen Smet, Jörg Wrachtrup
arxiv-2505-03003.description: Abstract The visualization of the magnetic responses of a two-dimensional (2D) superconducting material on the nanoscale is a powerful approach to unravel the underlying supercurrent behavior and to investigate critical phenomena in reduced dimensions. In this study, scanning quantum microscopy is utilized to explore the local magnetic response of the 2D superconductor 2H-NbSe 2 .

arxiv-2508-19221.title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Are readability metrics good measures of readability?
arxiv-2508-19221.creator: Isabel Cachola, Daniel Khashabi and Mark DredzeJohns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD 21211 {icachola, danielk, mdredze}@cs.jhu.edu
arxiv-2508-19221.description: Abstract Plain Language Summarization (PLS) aims to distill complex documents into accessible summaries for non-expert audiences. In this paper, we conduct a thorough survey of PLS literature, and identify that the current standard practice for readability evaluation is to use traditional readability metrics, such as Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL).

arxiv-2510-01667.creator: Oleksiy Dovgoshey, Olga Rovenska
arxiv-2510-01667.description: Abstract We prove the necessary and sufficient conditions under which ultrametric spaces of arbitrary infinite cardinality admit isometric embeddings into ultrametric spaces generated by labeled star graphs. MSC 2020. Primary 54E35, Secondary 54E4. Key words. Complete multipartite graph, diametrical graph, discrete ultrametric space, four-point condition, labeled star graph.

pmc-12471299.creator: Olga O Khmel, Anton N Yurchenko, Phan Thi Hoai Trinh, Ngo Thi Duy Ngoc, Vo Thi Dieu Trang, Huynh Hoang Nhu Khanh, Alexandr S Antonov, Konstantin A Drozdov, Roman S Popov, Natalya Y Kim, Dmitrii V Berdyshev, Ekaterina A Chingizova, Ekaterina S Menchinskaya, Ekaterina A Yurchenko, Stella Maria Casciof

pmc-12561990.title: HilE mediates motility thermoregulation in typhoidal Salmonella serovars at elevated physiological temperatures
pmc-12561990.creator: Rivka Shem-Tov, Ohad Gal-Mor, Matthew Wolfgang, Matthew Wolfgang, Matthew Wolfgang, Matthew Wolfgang
pmc-12561990.description: Salmonella enterica is a diverse bacterial pathogen consisting of both typhoidal and nontyphoidal clinically distinct serovars. While typhoidal serovars cause in humans a systemic life-threatening enteric fever, nontyphoidal Salmonella (NTS) usually provoke a localized self-limiting gastroenteritis. Factors responsible for the different diseases caused by distinct Salmonella serovars are still poorly understood.
